title: Evidence handling
practice: Hash a file, log it and fix a continuity gap.

lessons.title: Why originals are never changed
lessons.intro: If an original changes, nobody can be sure what it said before. So originals stay sealed, you work on verified copies, and you record anything you do.

tryit.prompt: You spot a typo in an original spreadsheet. What do you do?
options: Fix it in the original so the record is right
Changing an original destroys proof of what it said. Never do this.
Leave the original alone and note the issue in your working notes
Right. Note it, and work from a verified copy.
Delete the item, since it has an error
Removing evidence is worse still. Keep it and note the problem.

check.q: Who may change an original item?
options: The analyst, if it has a mistake

check.hint: Copies are checked against the original's hash.

options: So the evidence can still be relied on later
check.hint: Think about someone checking your work.

lessons.title: Hashes explained
lessons.intro: A hash is a fingerprint of a file. Change a single character and the fingerprint changes completely. Matching hashes show a copy is identical to the original.

tryit.prompt: Type in the box. Watch the SHA-256 fingerprint change completely with every character.

sandbox.task: Check the hash of the tracking export (EV-005).

check.q: You change one letter in a file. Its hash…
check.hint: Try it in the box above.

check.q: Two files have the same hash. This shows…
options: They were made on the same day
check.hint: That is what the fingerprint is for.

check.q: A hash check fails. What do you do?
options: Report it and do not rely on that copy
check.hint: Report problems; do not repair them.

lessons.title: Logging receipt and examination
lessons.intro: Every item needs its receipt logged before you open it. Logging records who received what and when. Examining is logged too, so the chain of custody has no gaps.

tryit.prompt: Put the steps in the right order.
items: Record a finding that cites it

sandbox.task: Log receipt of every item, then examine one.

steps.label: Log receipt of every item (Log all)

check.hint: You cannot examine what you have not received.

check.q: Opening an item before logging it causes…
check.hint: It is one of the procedural traps.

check.q: Where can you see every action you took?
check.hint: It is in the side panel.

lessons.title: Chain of custody and spotting a gap
lessons.intro: The chain of custody shows every hand an item passed through. A gap, such as an item examined before it was received, weakens it. A file that fails its hash must be reported, not fixed.

tryit.prompt: Click the line that breaks the chain of custody.
lines: 09:00 Received and sealed by case officer
tryit.explain: The analyst examined the item at 09:25 but only logged receipt at 09:40. That is a continuity gap.

sandbox.task: One item fails its hash check. Find it and report it.

check.q: An item was examined before receipt was logged. This is…
check.hint: Look at the order of events.

check.q: A copy fails its hash. You should…
options: Report it and use a verified copy
